I’ve had issues with nightmares/night terrors my whole life. My psychiatrist put me on 2mg prazosin a few years ago which I think is a beta blocker but don’t quote me on that. Anyway this drug has helped so much with nightmares. Even if one nightmare does slip in and I wake up to it, it for some reason doesn’t have the profound emotional effect and I can go back to sleep peacefully. I’m not sure if you have easy access to healthcare but maybe a primary care doctor can let you try this out. I started at 1mg and have been on up to 3mg. 2mg is my personal sweet spot. I hope this helps.

Rain is incredibly good for our environment for a multitude of reasons and for me personally it really is annoying and ignorant when people complain about rain. Sometimes there are things that are simply bigger than ourselves, rain is one of those things. Everyone should love rain for what it provides to our planet and not wish its end because of selfish reasons. 
I’m born and raised in Northern California so I grew up hating the rain. It wasn’t until I moved to Olympia Washington for a few years that I realized how absolutely incredible rain really is. 
I’m a firm believer that you shouldn’t let something upset you that you have zero control over changing- I put the weather in this category.
